research_evidence.title: Example Domain
research_evidence.persistence: research_sources + research_citations in the isolated engine DB
research_evidence.permission_model: NETWORK required; web-fetch capability grant required; manual profile returns needs_approval; trusted-auto-review can auto-approve. The extension never grants permissions.

limitations: No streaming; a chat turn is one request/response.
The extension does not grant permissions or write engine configuration; a working URL fetch requires an owner-created NETWORK grant, a web-fetch capability grant, and an explicit research profile.
Attachments are project-scoped prompt context; images are metadata-only and unsupported Office formats are reported honestly.
Fetched content is untrusted text; raw HTML/JS is not executed and is not exposed by the tool.
